text: Research: Wire, Crypto & Fintech and Money Lock desks dispatched in parallel (Money Lock's first-ever run). Lead picked from 22 candidate cards. Independent fact-check (no reporter notes) verified the lead (WIR-0002) and 2 alternates (CRY-0002 Bitget hack, LCK-0002 1933 gold confiscation) with no corrections to WIR-0002's facts. Standards check found 2 blocking legal-status gaps in the EN pack (WhatsApp and Facebook caption lacked the 'civil complaint, nothing proven, no individual named' framing present elsewhere) and fixed both; the same gap was then found and fixed in the FA and TR WhatsApp posts. No other blocking issues. Advisory only: keep reel captions carrying the civil-case line when finalized, and keep the illustrated 'certificate' prop generic (no SEC-specific iconography). A stock check of 6 leftover drafts from edition 01 was also completed this cycle and filed separately (CON-0002, CON-0003, REG-0006, ODD-0003 verified; REG-0005 downgraded to Needs-2nd-source over a disputed date; ODD-0007 verified as a myth-buster). Held back from this edition, pending your decision on the open regional-politics question in CLAUDE.md: Turkey's $18B fund-fraud scandal (political angle only), Cyprus's 2013 bail-in, and frozen Iranian central-bank reserves. Also held back regardless of that question: a Tehran Bitcoin-murder case with unresolved source conflicts and graphic content.
